ABOUT PASTOR THOZI
"True leadership is not about the position you hold — it is about the lives you transform."

Thomas Thozamile "Thozi" Gwanya is one of South Africa's most respected development practitioners and leadership experts. His distinguished career spans government, community development, land reform, governance and executive leadership — from the rural Eastern Cape to the halls of national government.
